misc.title: #ONEPIECE1190 Mojr isn't wrong. People act as if Kaido or Big Mom are a tier above Rayleigh or Gaban, but they overlook two facts: in terms of portrayal, Garp placed Rayleigh on the same level as Whit
misc.text: #ONEPIECE1190 Mojr isn't wrong. People act as if Kaido or Big Mom are a tier above Rayleigh or Gaban, but they overlook two facts: in terms of portrayal, Garp placed Rayleigh on the same level as Whitebeard. Teach, who had no qualms about fighting Law (the one who defeated Big Mom), preferred not to tangle with Rayleigh. Rayleigh's portrayal speaks for itself. Then there’s the fact that Kaido almost lost to Oden. And let's be honest: in my eyes, Oden isn't stronger than Rayleigh or Gaban. If an Oden who was already weakened could inflict such a wound on Kaido, I shudder to think what would happen if a "Divine Gate" actually hit him. It’s not a fight where one side completely destroys the other. Kaido, Big Mom, Rayleigh, and Gaban are all on the same level. It makes sense for the Pirate King's "Wings" to be on the same tier as the Yonko. It would be a extrem either way battle between these four(Kaido,Big Mom, Gaban or Rayleigh)... Ziller (@ZillerCritic) Morj finally cooked 😭 Yes, Prime Ray & Gaban > Kaido & BM It’s so obvious Video — https://nitter.net/ZillerCritic/status/2086155841057480896#m
